title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 dashboard for managers in Copilot Analytics
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, default state and control paths are supported. Minor corrections concern the action rating, conflicting Microsoft guidance on the web app administrator role, and a hierarchy checklist step without a corresponding control row.

claims.quote: enabling them to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365.

claims.quote: Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

claims.claim: The cited pages quote no separate charge for the dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Agent Dashboard Agent 365 manager dashboard licensing settings; read agent-dashboard, manage-settings-copilot-dashboard, manager-settings, Agent 365 overview and Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy. They name licensing, not a separate dashboard price.

claims.where: front matter: action; Why it matters
claims.claim: The review action rating treats the change as optional despite the verified on-by-default dashboard and automatic access for already-enabled managers.
claims.quote: action: "review" ... The Agent Dashboard is on by default within the Viva Insights web app; enabled managers with existing team-level Copilot Analytics access can also view their enabled teams. Check existing access before rollout.
claims.fix: Change action from review to prepare: the change reaches existing enabled managers without a new choice, and requires access and privacy decisions. Retain the explicit uncertainty over the stale August CY2026 target and In development status.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, hierarchy checklist step
claims.claim: The checklist instructs administrators to verify the manager hierarchy or uploaded organisational data, but no control row represents that check.
claims.quote: Verify the manager hierarchy in Microsoft Entra ID, or in the uploaded organisational data file if you use one ... Rows cover dashboard availability, web app availability, manager access and minimum group size.
claims.fix: Remove the 'Verify the manager hierarchy' checklist bullet, which has no corresponding control row. Keep the supported explanation of the hierarchy and uploaded-data behaviour in Risk assessment.

claims.claim: Learn labels the Agent Dashboard page as preview and the settings page restricts the Agent Dashboard to public preview customers, unlike the roadmap's General Availability phase.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.where: Scope: Clouds and platform; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn says the dashboard is not currently available in national/regional clouds, including U.S. Government clouds, conflicting with the roadmap's GCC listing.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard isn't currently available for national/regional cloud deployments including but not limited to Microsoft's U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.

claims.claim: The manager settings page names the Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and Consumption Dashboard as the experiences it governs.
claims.quote: you can set up and edit Manager settings to allow all measured people managers or a specified group of managers to access aggregated insights about their team in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and the Consumption Dashboard in the Viva Insights web app.
